targeted_original_paragraphs: 动作：将推床移到有侧向空间的位置→稳住车体、调整角度→推动车身横向逼近→停止施力→退床恢复。
人物与物件：推床随同一转运工移动；床上不另生出第二名被转运患者。人死亡后车体留在实际位置，但不能永久封路。
维护通道内人物、车体与杂物移动时保留返回路径；大型敌人无法进入时，不固定守住唯一入口。
implementation: Same bed and operator; sampled rigid pose/turn and side grip. Only known adjacent portal followed; no target location bestowed in unseen room. Clear both sides before frame mapping. Blocked/narrow doors withdraw, mid-entry new obstruction reverses physically; real doorway side lane prevents stationary corpse-bed center-lock.
limitations: full hostile crowd combinations and both mouths blocked at once are not accepted
world remains code placeholder; original art, voice and music unchanged
ordinary travel blocks on contact; only established side attack deals original damage
